summary: Landed the two opt-in witness host mechanisms (Playwright setInputFiles behind a per-AppSpec declaration recording fixture path/name/bytes/sha256; acceptDownloads plus a capturedDownloads readback, both granted only by declaration) and the tiny-translator core schema with parser/renderer/verifier/aggregate member, barrel-exported. Added generic file-input and download evidence types to witness-real-app.ts and the app to the closed name list. Tests: 17 CLI mechanism positives/negatives including a walk over every existing spec proving neither opt-in is declared, and 27 core schema round-trip/rejection tests. tsc clean, vp lint 0 errors, 204 files / 1894 tests pass. No journeys, no publish, nothing committed.
open_questions: The migrated lane's font seam is pinned by origin (fonts.gstatic.com, provably not fonts.googleapis.com) rather than by full path: the dist-7 stage tree is gone, so the provider-minted versioned woff2 path was unreadable and was not invented. The published receipt must pin the exact member, identically across all four runs.
Readiness numbers (angularLineage 1/4 counted:false, overall 3/12) follow the factoriolab idiom; the publish unit should confirm them against the aggregate at publish time.
